title: DiPrinter
description: A simple mod allowing users to build Diks faster
body:
# DIPrinter Mod Features
DIPrinter is a Fabric client-side mod for Minecraft that provides two automated building modes ("Dik" and "Beta"), along with aura‑based auto‑building, helper block management, preview rendering, and extensive configuration options.

## 🧱 Building Modes
### Dik Mode
- Builds a structure resembling a “Dik”:

  - Starts with a helper block (the base).

  - Adds two side blocks (“wings”) to the left and right.

  - Extends forward for a configurable length (default 3 blocks, max 4, min 2).

- Triggered by right‑clicking on a block while holding a block item.

- Can be enabled/disabled via hotkey.

### Beta Mode
- Builds a different multi‑block pattern:

  - A central column of building blocks (2 high).

  - Two side arms at the middle level.

  - Two side arms at the top level.

  - A top cap.

- Triggered similarly with a right‑click.

- Also togglable via hotkey.

## ✨ Aura (Auto‑Building)
- Dik Aura and Beta Aura automatically scan the area around the player (configurable radius, 3–7 blocks).

- When a valid placement spot is found, the corresponding structure is built automatically without manual clicking.

- Scans once every 500 ms to avoid performance issues.

- If both auras are enabled, you can choose which one takes priority.

## 🔧 Helper Blocks & Breaking Assistance
- Some positions in the structures are marked as helper blocks (temporary).

- After placing all building blocks, the helper blocks are automatically broken.

- Softest‑block selection – the mod can automatically choose the easiest‑to‑break block from your inventory for helper blocks.

- Best‑tool selection – when breaking helpers, the mod automatically switches to the most effective tool for that block.

- Breaking is done with simulated player interactions (left‑click continues).

## 🎮 Configuration & Controls
- GUI – press D + C (default) to open the full configuration screen, organised into three tabs:

  - Construction – enable/disable Dik/Beta modes and auras.

  - Misc – placement delay, player rotation, Dik length, aura radius, helper block preferences, etc.

  - Render – structure preview and aura preview toggles.

- All hotkeys can be rebound through the in‑game controls menu (malilib integration).

## 👁️ Preview Rendering
- **Structure Preview** – when aiming at a block and ready to build, a translucent overlay shows exactly where each block will be placed (building blocks and helpers).

- **Aura Preview** – while an aura is active, the next structure to be built is shown transparently around the player until it is placed or cancelled.

## 🧠 Other Features
- Player Rotation – automatically rotates the player to face each placement position (can be disabled).

## 🛠️ Requirements
- Fabric Loader

- Fabric API

- malilib (required for config GUI and keybindings)
